text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Fall Senior Triple Crown—not achieved. 
Though narrowly missing out on the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn)...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe! She has conquered this 
year's Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Claiming two of the Fall Senior Triple 
Crown races! This autumn and winter, she 
was unmistakably one of the leading stars!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's all good, Universe-chan! Ah~ I'm 
frustrated! But somehow, super happy too!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
A Starship, huh? Haha, I dunno, but it was 
like she was floating right over the 
waves!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Uni-san can surely see it... The path of 
stars charted across the turf.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The congratulations of her rivals. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Neo Universe has once again 
Returned."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Carrying 'moon dust' once again. Even 
though there were 'satellites' that never 
made it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Throughout this autumn and winter, her 
condition steadily climbed as the latter 
half approached.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yes, Neo Universe's angle of ascent is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We're definitely ascending. Toward our 
destination, the space station above the 
atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Universe! Trainer gets "moon dust", 
but what about my souvenir!?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Quantum data. Bringing "GATC" to the 
evolution of magic...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What the heck is that~?! I wanted 
something way more fun than this~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An invisible souvenir. An invisible bond. 
Her connection with her junior Umamusume 
progressed even further.
